scripts.scrape:bg: mkdir -p logs data && nohup caffeinate -dimsu node scrape_playwright.js > logs/scrape.log 2>&1 & echo $! > data/scraper.pid && echo "バックグラウンド開始 → npm run scrape:log"
scripts.scrape:stop: cat data/scraper.pid 2>/dev/null | xargs kill && echo '停止' || echo 'PIDなし'
scripts.scrape:medicine:bg: mkdir -p logs data && nohup caffeinate -dimsu node scrape_medicine.js > logs/medicine-scrape.log 2>&1 & echo $! > data/medicine-scraper.pid && echo "medicine.shop バックグラウンド開始 → npm run scrape:medicine:log"
scripts.scrape:medicine:stop: cat data/medicine-scraper.pid 2>/dev/null | xargs kill && echo '停止' || echo 'PIDなし'
scripts.refresh: node scrape_medicine.js && node db-sync.js --detect-changes && node monitor.js --notify
scripts.refresh:bg: mkdir -p logs data && nohup caffeinate -dimsu sh -c 'node scrape_medicine.js && node db-sync.js --detect-changes && node monitor.js --notify' > logs/refresh.log 2>&1 & echo $! > data/refresh.pid && echo "refresh バックグラウンド開始 → tail -f logs/refresh.log"
scripts.count: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['data/medicine-products.json','data/medicine-done-ids.json','data/medicine-missing-ids.json','data/medicine-errors.json','data/products.json']) { if (fs.existsSync(f)) { const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')); console.log(f, Array.isArray(d)?d.length:Object.keys(d).length); } }"
